description: Compare two .xlsx (or .csv) files cell by cell and return the differences as JSON: {summary, added, removed, changed, format_changed}. Cells are matched on (sheet title, cell ref); changed covers value and formula changes, and format-only changes are listed separately. Use it to see what changed between two versions of a file, such as before and after an edit. For problems inside one workbook use audit_workbook; to undo edits in a session use restore_session. Provide exactly one of before_path/before_url/before_base64 and one of after_path/after_url/after_base64. Both files are uploaded to and parsed on the Basis API (up to 20 MB each) and count against the API key's parse quota; nothing is stored.

after_base64.description: Base64-encoded bytes of the second (after) .xlsx or .csv file

after_path.description: Local filesystem path to the second (after) .xlsx or .csv file

after_url.description: URL to fetch the second (after) .xlsx or .csv file from

before_base64.description: Base64-encoded bytes of the first (before) .xlsx or .csv file

before_path.description: Local filesystem path to the first (before) .xlsx or .csv file

before_url.description: URL to fetch the first (before) .xlsx or .csv file from

include_format.description: Report cells whose only change is number format (default true)

name: diff_workbooks
title: Diff workbooks
